approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and Cell SPU code to C/C++ (custom lifters; lifted SPU jobs plus an SPU interpreter for the rest), on a reimplementation of the PS3 OS and libraries. Metal renderer, VideoToolbox for cutscenes, CoreAudio, GameController input. Runs natively on Apple Silicon, no emulator and no JIT.

links.label: Sister project: God of War II HD

help: Levels after the first one are not verified
Android and iOS builds: planned. The same runtime already runs God of War II HD there, but nothing has been built or tested for this title yet
Frame rate on fanless Macs (the game's own limiter is 30 fps, it also has a 60 Hz mode)
Publishing the engine fork so the port can be built from scratch
notes: macOS is the only target so far: boot, intro videos, title, front-end hub, New Game and the first level (walking, dialogue, HUD) run natively on Apple Silicon. Android and iOS are planned, not tested for this title. No game code or assets are in this repository; the port needs your own copy of the game. See the README for the status table and the notes/ folder for the engineering log.
